name: Construction Project Proposal
tagline: Construction proposal deck with slate technical geometry, peach accents, dotted plan fields, architectural linework, and balanced white pages.

palette.description: Dark slate technical backgrounds, peach bars and blocks, off-white pages, muted gray text, and blueprint-style linework.

typography.style: Rounded geometric sans with centered proposal headings, numeric lists, and architectural diagram accents.

best_for: Construction proposals, architecture plans, built environment portfolios, project scopes, and service capability presentations.
avoid_for: Playful workshops, highly colorful marketing decks, or emotive consumer storytelling.

source_inspiration.name: Slidesgo Construction Project Proposal
source_inspiration.notes: Rebuilt as source-inspired portable HTML/CSS from public visual references; no source asset files are embedded.
